title: Spiced Hot Chocolate
summary: Fill a microwave-safe mug with skimmed milk, microwave it for 1 minute, add sugar, chocolate and cinnamon, mix, then heat for another minute and serve.
source: CaptainCook4D recipe text + task graph (Spiced Hot Chocolate); mistake hints from train split

nodes.name: Heat for 1 minute and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the mug back in the microwave on full power for 1 minute. Then take it out carefully and serve your hot chocolate.
substeps: Place the mug in the center of the microwave.
Set full power and 1 minute, then start.
Carefully take the hot mug out.
Set it on the table ready to drink.
nodes.end_state: The steaming mug of brown hot chocolate sits on the table or counter ready to drink, with the microwave empty.
nodes.view_hint: the microwave display during heating, then the mug on the table

checks.question: Is the microwave set to 1 minute at full power?
Is the finished hot chocolate out of the microwave and set down to serve?

mistakes.description: Heated for 2 minutes instead of 1.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows 2:00 at start.
mistakes.correction: That's 2 minutes. Set it to 1 minute instead.
mistakes.early_cue: Pressing the minute button twice.

mistakes.description: Heated far too briefly, like 8 or 40 seconds, or stopped a long countdown early.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display under one minute, or a countdown cancelled with time left.
mistakes.correction: That wasn't a full minute. Pop it back in and finish the remaining time.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand hovering over the stop button early in the cycle.

mistakes.description: Used low power, or mixed low and high power settings.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows Low or a low power percentage during the cycle.
mistakes.correction: Power is set too low. Use full power for the whole minute.
mistakes.early_cue: Pressing the power level button before starting.

mistakes.description: Served on an improper item like the microwave glass plate cover.
mistakes.visual_cue: Mug set on a glass microwave cover or plate instead of a table or saucer.
mistakes.correction: Take the mug off that cover and set it on the table or a saucer to serve.
mistakes.early_cue: Lifting the microwave cover out along with the mug.

nodes.name: Add 1/5 teaspoon cinnamon
nodes.instruction_novice: Add a tiny pinch of cinnamon, about one fifth of a teaspoon, to the mug. Measure it in the spoon first rather than fixing it in the milk.
substeps: Pick up the cinnamon jar and check the label.
Put a small amount, about a fifth of a teaspoon, in a teaspoon.
Tap it gently into the mug.
Close the cinnamon jar.
nodes.end_state: A light dusting of brown cinnamon sits on the milk surface, with no spill around the mug.
nodes.view_hint: the spice jar label, the spoon, and the surface of the milk

checks.question: Does the spice jar label say cinnamon?
Is only a small pinch of cinnamon, well under a quarter teaspoon, added?
Is the counter free of spilled cinnamon?

mistakes.description: Added cumin instead of cinnamon.
mistakes.visual_cue: Jar label reads cumin; powder is yellow-brown and coarser.
mistakes.correction: That's cumin, not cinnamon. Swap jars before you add it.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picking up the cumin jar.

mistakes.description: Added a quarter teaspoon or more instead of a fifth.
mistakes.visual_cue: Spoon clearly filled past a small pinch, or a thick brown layer on the milk.
mistakes.correction: That's a bit too much cinnamon. Aim for just a small pinch, about a fifth of a teaspoon.
mistakes.early_cue: Using a quarter-teaspoon measure or a heaped spoon.

mistakes.description: Added too much, then scooped cinnamon back off the milk; or spilled while adding.
mistakes.visual_cue: Spoon skimming the milk surface to remove cinnamon, or brown powder on the counter.
mistakes.correction: Measure the cinnamon in the spoon first, then add it. Don't scoop it back out of the milk, and wipe up any spill.
mistakes.early_cue: Shaking the jar directly over the mug.

nodes.name: Mix the contents
nodes.instruction_novice: Stir the mug slowly in circles with a spoon until the chocolate and sugar are dissolved. Keep the motion gentle so nothing splashes out.
nodes.instruction_expert: Stir slowly in circles until smooth
substeps: Put a spoon into the mug.
Stir slowly in a circular motion.
Keep stirring until no chocolate lumps remain.
Lift the spoon out and rest it on the counter.
nodes.end_state: The liquid in the mug is a uniform light brown with no chocolate pieces or sugar visible, and the surface is calm.

checks.question: Is the liquid an even brown color with no chocolate pieces visible?
Is the counter around the mug free of splashes?

mistakes.description: Stirred hastily or with up-down and sideways motions, spilling milk.
mistakes.visual_cue: Fast jerky spoon movement, liquid sloshing over the rim, drips on the counter.
mistakes.correction: Slow down and stir in gentle circles so the milk stays in the mug.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon plunging up and down rapidly.

mistakes.description: Did not mix thoroughly; chocolate and sugar not dissolved.
mistakes.visual_cue: Chocolate lumps or sugar grains still visible, streaky color in the mug.
mistakes.correction: Keep stirring a bit longer until the chocolate is fully melted and the color is even.
mistakes.early_cue: Only two or three quick stirs before setting the spoon down.

mistakes.description: Mixed before adding the chocolate, sugar or cinnamon.
mistakes.visual_cue: Stirring plain white milk with no chocolate, sugar or cinnamon added.
mistakes.correction: Add the sugar, chocolate and cinnamon first, then mix everything together.
mistakes.early_cue: Picking up a stirring spoon right after taking the mug out of the microwave.

nodes.name: Add 1 teaspoon white sugar
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure one level teaspoon of white sugar and tip it into the warm milk. Use the small teaspoon, not the big tablespoon.
substeps: Pick up a teaspoon measure.
Scoop white sugar and level it off.
Tip it into the mug.
Set the spoon aside.
nodes.end_state: White sugar grains are visible sinking into or dissolving in the warm milk, and a used teaspoon lies nearby.
nodes.view_hint: the sugar container, the spoon and the mug opening

checks.question: Is a small teaspoon being used, not a tablespoon?
Is the container being used labeled white sugar?
Has exactly one spoonful been added to the mug?

mistakes.description: Used a tablespoon instead of a teaspoon.
mistakes.visual_cue: A large spoon heaped with sugar going into the mug.
mistakes.correction: That's a tablespoon. Use the smaller teaspoon for the sugar.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand picking the largest spoon from the measuring set.

mistakes.description: Added two teaspoons instead of one.
mistakes.visual_cue: Spoon dips into the sugar and goes to the mug a second time.
mistakes.correction: That's two teaspoons. The recipe only needs one, so skip the second.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon going back to the sugar container after the first scoop.

mistakes.description: Added corn starch or another white powder instead of sugar.
mistakes.visual_cue: Container label reads corn starch; powder is fine and dusty rather than grainy.
mistakes.correction: That's corn starch, not sugar. Grab the white sugar instead.
mistakes.early_cue: Reaching for a corn starch box.

nodes.name: Fill mug with skimmed milk
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab a clean, microwave-safe mug and fill it nearly to the top with skimmed milk. Pour slowly so nothing spills.
nodes.instruction_expert: Fill clean mug with skimmed milk
substeps: Pick a clean mug marked microwave-safe.
Open the skimmed milk carton or bottle.
Pour slowly until the mug is full, about a finger-width below the rim.
Set the milk down and wipe any drips.
nodes.end_state: A clean mug stands on the counter filled with white milk close to the rim, with no puddles around it.
nodes.view_hint: the mug on the counter from above, including the milk carton label

checks.question: Is the mug filled with milk nearly to the rim?
Does the milk container say skimmed (not whole) milk?
Is the counter around the mug free of spilled milk?

mistakes.description: Used whole milk instead of skimmed milk.
mistakes.visual_cue: Milk carton label reads whole or full-fat milk, often a blue or red cap.
mistakes.correction: That's whole milk. Swap it for the skimmed milk carton before you pour.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaching for the whole milk carton in the fridge.

mistakes.description: Only filled the mug halfway.
mistakes.visual_cue: Milk level sits around the middle of the mug with lots of empty space above.
mistakes.correction: The mug is only half full. Top it up with skimmed milk almost to the rim.
mistakes.early_cue: Pouring stops early while the mug is still mostly empty.

mistakes.description: Spilled milk while filling.
mistakes.visual_cue: White puddle or drips on the counter and down the mug side.
mistakes.correction: Some milk spilled. Pour more slowly and wipe up the counter before moving on.
mistakes.early_cue: Carton tilted steeply with a fast stream of milk.

mistakes.description: Used a dirty, unwashed mug.
mistakes.visual_cue: Residue, stains or old liquid visible inside the mug before pouring.
mistakes.correction: That mug looks dirty. Wash it or pick a clean one first.
mistakes.early_cue: Mug picked up from the sink or with visible residue inside.

nodes.name: Microwave milk for 1 minute
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the mug in the microwave and heat it on full power for exactly 1 minute. Take it out carefully when it beeps.
substeps: Place the mug in the center of the microwave plate.
Set power to high, 100 percent.
Set the timer to 1 minute and start.
Carefully remove the mug when done.
nodes.end_state: The mug of warm milk sits outside the microwave, possibly with faint steam, and the microwave display shows the cycle has ended.
nodes.view_hint: the microwave control panel and display, then the mug inside

checks.question: Does the microwave timer show 1:00 when started?
Is the microwave running at full or high power?
Has the mug been removed from the microwave after the cycle?

mistakes.description: Set the timer for 2 minutes instead of 1.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display reads 2:00 at start.
mistakes.correction: That's set to 2 minutes. Stop it and set it to 1 minute.
mistakes.early_cue: Pressing the 2 or the minute button twice.

mistakes.description: Heated for too short a time, like 35 or 45 seconds, or stopped a longer countdown early.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows under a minute, or a long countdown is interrupted with time remaining.
mistakes.correction: That wasn't a full minute. Put it back and heat for the rest of the time.
mistakes.early_cue: Timer set to an odd long value like 7:00 with the hand hovering over stop.

mistakes.description: Set the power level to low, such as 10 percent, instead of 100 percent.
mistakes.visual_cue: Display shows a low power level like P10 or Low.
mistakes.correction: The power is set too low. Change it to full power before you start.
mistakes.early_cue: Pressing the power level button repeatedly.

mistakes.description: Added sugar, chocolate or cinnamon before microwaving.
mistakes.visual_cue: Sugar, chocolate pieces or brown powder visible in the milk before it goes into the microwave.
mistakes.correction: Microwave the plain milk first, then add the sugar, chocolate and cinnamon.
mistakes.early_cue: Reaching for sugar or chocolate while the mug is still on the counter unheated.

nodes.name: Add 2 pieces of chocolate
nodes.instruction_novice: Break off two pieces of chocolate and drop them into the warm milk. Just two, so count them.
substeps: Unwrap the chocolate bar.
Snap off two squares.
Drop both into the mug.
Put the rest of the bar away.
nodes.end_state: Two chocolate squares are in the mug, starting to melt into the milk.
nodes.view_hint: the mug opening and the chocolate bar in hand

checks.question: Are exactly two pieces of chocolate broken off?
Are the chocolate pieces in the mug?

mistakes.description: Added four or five pieces instead of two.
mistakes.visual_cue: More than two chocolate squares in hand or floating in the mug.
mistakes.correction: That's too much chocolate. You only need two pieces, so fish out the extras.
mistakes.early_cue: Snapping off a large strip of several squares.

mistakes.description: Added only one piece.
mistakes.visual_cue: A single square in the mug and the bar put away.
mistakes.correction: Only one piece went in. Add one more piece of chocolate.
mistakes.early_cue: Snapping off a single square.

mistakes.description: Chocolate added after the mixing step.
mistakes.visual_cue: Spoon already stirring the mug before any chocolate has gone in.
mistakes.correction: Add the chocolate first, then mix everything together.
mistakes.early_cue: Picking up a stirring spoon while the chocolate bar is still wrapped.
